locators.title: Diophantine Analysis and Approximations, Chapter18, pp158–159
An elementary approach to Roth’s theorem, Section4

summary: Princeton notes explicitly encode selected diagonal derivatives by remainders, count all coefficient tuples, and find two distinct inputs with matching tuples. Milojevic instead organizes the construction through a linear system and subtracts two vectors with equal images. These support the distinction between polynomial observation recovery and generic finite collision.
